item_name: Autorizzazione Unica ex art. 12 D.Lgs. 387/2003
authority: Provincia di Alessandria - Direzione Ambiente Viabilita 1
required_for: Construction and operation of the 8169.525 kWp plant and its grid connection
blocker_impact: Without it no construction may take place.
comments: Works must start within three years of issue and finish within three years of their start, subject to any extension granted.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Giudizio positivo di compatibilita ambientale (VIA screening)
blocker_impact: Its environmental prescriptions bind the execution of the works.
comments: Allegato A of the AU makes the listed authority opinions binding.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Definitive land purchase contract replacing the preliminary contracts
required_for: Start of works; failure voids the authorisation
blocker_impact: The authorisation lapses if not provided.
comments: Due before the start of works and in any case within 150 days of publication of the AU on the provincial Albo pretorio. DATA REQUIRED: the Albo pretorio publication date, to compute the deadline.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Financial guarantee of EUR 50.00 per kW in favour of the Comune
comments: Due within 150 days of publication and in any case before the start of works. DATA REQUIRED: the Albo pretorio publication date.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Decommissioning surety bond at 100% of the sworn decommissioning cost
blocker_impact: Failure to provide it voids the authorisation.
comments: To be revalued every five years against programmed inflation. Excludes the grid connection works, which remain the Distributor's asset.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Executive design (progetto esecutivo) submitted to the Provincia
blocker_impact: Works may not start before submission.
comments: Must be prepared per NTC 2018 (D.M. 17.01.2018) and include the geotechnical and structural reports and the sizing and drawings of the main and secondary stormwater drainage channels. Must follow the preliminary plan for on-site reuse of excavated soil per art. 24 comma 3 DPR 120/2017.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Notification of works start and completion dates
authority: Provincia di Alessandria, Comune di Bassignana, Arpa Piemonte, ASL-AL and all consenting bodies
comments: Must be sent together with the D.Lgs. 81/2008 notifications, and must name the executing company and the Works Director. Any substitution must be notified immediately with signed acceptance.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Site organisation not to obstruct the road network
blocker_impact: Traffic management condition on the site setup.
comments: Construction phases must be organised so as not to obstruct the affected road network or local traffic.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Acoustic classification compatibility verification
authority: Provincia di Alessandria / Comune di Bassignana
comments: Within six months of BUR publication of the acoustic classification approval notice, verify compatibility of the noise emissions with its limits and, if necessary, adapt or submit a remediation plan.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Acoustic impact monitoring campaign with the plant in operation
comments: To be submitted within 60 days of the date on which all new plant reaches steady-state operation.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Collaudo certificate transmitted to the Provincia
blocker_impact: Statutory obligation at the end of the works.
comments: The commissioning or equivalent certificate must be sent to the Province at the end of the works.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Compensatory works for the Po river park authority
authority: Ente di gestione delle Aree protette del Po Piemontese
comments: The required works must be carried out at the first suitable planting season.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Convenzione for compensatory works with the Comune di Bassignana
document_reference: Deliberazione di Giunta n. 35 of 08.05.2024, n.p.g. 32388 of 24.06.2024
comments: Acknowledged in AU clause 7.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Grid connection works by E-Distribuzione
required_for: Connection of the plant to the MV distribution network
document_reference: POD IT001E108161205; codice rintracciabilita 313043600; codice presa 0632928200003; codice fornitura 108161205
blocker_impact: Energisation cannot occur before the connection is built and commissioned.
comments: Route shared between several producers. Start of the connection works is conditional on submitting evidence of all concessions, easements and public land occupation permits still to be obtained.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

item_name: Concessions, easements and public land occupation permits for the cable route
authority: Competent bodies along the route (Comuni di Bassignana, Pecetto di Valenza, Valenza; road authorities)
required_for: Start of the grid connection works
blocker_impact: The connection works cannot start until these are evidenced to the Province.
source: Autorizzazione Unica - Provincia di Alessandria, Determinazione DDVA4-733-2024 of 08.08.2024

comments: Listed in Allegato A of the AU.

authority: Snam Rete Gas Spa, Italgas Reti Spa, SARPOM, AM+ Spa
